name: Obsidian-App
description: Obsidian is a powerful and extensible knowledge base that works on top of a local folder of plain text Markdown files. This script installs Obsidian with a web-based VNC interface for remote access.

notes.text: Obsidian is accessible via a web browser. The VNC password can be found in the container at /root/Obsidian-App.creds.
Consider creating a `/vaults` directory in the LXC and mounting your Obsidian vaults there for data persistence. You can do this via Proxmox's LXC 'Resources' > 'Mount Point' settings.
